name: nudge
description: Nudge — the ND-1 wall device, its hub, and the apps that sync with it.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w pi-screen && npm run build -w apps && npm run build -w pi-hub
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run dist -w windows-desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w pi-hub && npm run test -w windows-desktop
